name: Detroit Jacket
description: Carhartt WIP's Detroit Jacket is a short, boxy work jacket in rinsed organic cotton Dearborn canvas that starts stiff and fades along the seams and pocket edges as it wears in. A corduroy collar and a quilted lining keep it on rotation from September until the first hard frost. Rugged with double-knees and boots, and just as good thrown over a hoodie with baggy denim.
details: Boxy, cropped fit; true to size
Metal snap front, zip chest pocket, two hand pockets

name: Halo Cropped Puffer
description: A short, high-gloss puffer that stops right at the waist and is cut wide through the body, so it sits boxy over a baby tee or a cropped hoodie. The shell is a liquid-shine recycled nylon with a stand collar that zips up past the chin and a small reflective tab at the back. Loud in metallic silver, sharp in black, and very early-2000s with low-rise cargos and slim sneakers.
details: Shell: 100% recycled nylon ripstop, gloss finish
Cropped, boxy fit; hits at the natural waist
Two-way front zip, snap hand pockets
Machine wash cold on gentle, tumble dry low

name: Firebird Track Top
description: The Firebird is Adidas' archive track top, in smooth recycled tricot with the three stripes running down the sleeves and a contrast stand collar. It is cut slim through the body with ribbed cuffs and hem, so it zips up neatly over a tee and looks right with matching track pants, a pleated mini or baggy jeans. Sporty, a little retro and easy to throw on.
details: Slim fit; size up for a looser look
Full zip with stand collar, zip hand pockets

name: Hawthorne Waxed Chore Coat
description: The Hawthorne is a hip-length chore coat in 10 oz waxed cotton canvas, deep tobacco brown, with four patch pockets, a blanket-lined body and triple-stitched seams. The wax sheds drizzle and picks up creases and scuffs that make each coat look like its owner's, and the workshop will re-wax and repair it for life. Boxy and utilitarian, it goes over a flannel on a trail weekend or a hoodie in town.
details: 10 oz waxed cotton canvas, woven in the USA
Wool-blend blanket lining in body; cotton-lined sleeves
Relaxed, boxy fit; sized to layer over a sweater
Brass snaps, four patch pockets, interior map pocket
Cut and sewn in Portland, Oregon
imageQuery: waxed canvas chore coat brown man

name: Kennebunk Barn Jacket
description: The Kennebunk is a New England barn jacket in khaki waxed cotton with a chocolate corduroy collar and a brushed tartan flannel lining. It falls just past the hip with bellows pockets and a straight, easy shape that layers over an oxford shirt and a shetland crewneck. Crisp on day one, it softens into the kind of jacket that gets handed down.
details: 8 oz waxed cotton; 100% cotton corduroy collar
Lined in brushed cotton tartan flannel
Regular fit; room for a sweater underneath
Brass two-way zip with storm flap, snap-down bellows pockets
Re-wax when needed; do not machine wash

name: Hanover Varsity Jacket
description: A proper varsity jacket in heavy navy melton wool with cream leather sleeves, striped knit trims and a chenille letter patch on the chest. It is cut regular through the body with snap closures and a quilted satin lining, so it reads collegiate with chinos and loafers or louder over a hoodie and wide jeans. The leather softens and creases with years of wear.
details: Quilted satin lining; striped rib collar, cuffs and hem

name: Deià Linen Chore Jacket
description: An unlined chore jacket in washed European linen, garment-dyed a pale sand so it already looks a summer old. It hangs loose and boxy with three patch pockets and corozo buttons, light enough to throw over a tee on a breezy evening by the water or to pack flat for a trip. Creases are part of the look.

name: Frøya Quilted Floral Jacket
description: The Frøya is a lightweight quilted jacket in printed cotton voile, scattered with small faded roses on a cream ground and finished with a scalloped edge and a ribbon tie at the neck. It is channel-quilted over a thin cotton wadding, so it feels more like a padded blouse than a coat, and sits loose at the hip. Soft and romantic over a prairie dress, or with jeans and a broderie top.
details: Ribbon tie at neck, covered-button front, scalloped hem
Gentle machine wash cold, dry flat

name: Rauch Washed Leather Biker
description: Asche's Rauch biker is cut from lambskin that is washed and tumbled until it goes soft and faintly crackled, in a black that turns almost charcoal at the creases. The asymmetric zip, belted hem and antiqued silver hardware are heavy on purpose, and the shoulders are cut a little sharp. Moody over long drape jersey with heavy boots.
details: Regular fit with a slightly cropped body
imageQuery: black washed leather biker jacket woman

name: '90s Trucker Jacket
description: Levi's '90s Trucker takes the Type III shape and blows it out, with dropped shoulders, a roomy body and a slightly shorter length in a light vintage wash with fading at the elbows and seams. It is rigid cotton denim with pleated front panels, flap chest pockets and the red tab. Wear it over a baby tee with low-rise jeans, or with a slip skirt and slim sneakers.
details: Button front, flap chest pockets, welt hand pockets
imageQuery: levis oversized denim trucker jacket woman

name: Sashiko Boro Coverall Jacket
description: Kapital builds this coverall jacket from hand-dyed indigo cotton, patched with scraps of older boro cloth and stitched over by hand in white sashiko thread. No two are alike: the patches, fades and running stitches change from jacket to jacket, and the indigo keeps shifting as it is worn and washed. A boxy work-coat shape with four patch pockets, it carries a whole outfit with plain trousers and a white tee.
details: 100% cotton, hand-dyed indigo with patchwork panels
Hand sashiko stitching; each piece is unique
Hand wash cold separately; indigo will transfer

name: Schatten Long Wool Coat
description: A long single-breasted coat in heavy black boiled wool that falls to mid-calf, with a high notch lapel, concealed buttons and a deep back vent so it moves when you walk. There is no logo and almost no detail; the length and the weight do the work. It layers over a hoodie as easily as over a suit, for anyone who wears black all winter.
details: 90% virgin wool, 10% cashmere boiled wool, 680 gsm
Relaxed fit; mid-calf length (125 cm on size M)

name: Kohle Long Leather Coat
description: The Kohle is a long leather coat in washed black cowhide that reaches below the knee, with a wide collar, a self-tie belt and heavy silver buckles at the cuffs. The hide is tumbled to a soft, uneven matte so it looks lived-in from the first wear. Dramatic and moody over black denim and combat boots.
details: Antiqued silver cuff buckles, horn buttons

name: Hayle Oversized Wool Coat
description: An oversized single-breasted overcoat in Italian wool-cashmere melton, cut long and dropped at the shoulder so it drapes rather than holds a shape. It comes in a warm undyed ecru with dark horn buttons and is half-lined for a lighter feel. Calm and considered over wide pleated trousers and a fine-gauge knit.
details: 80% wool, 20% cashmere melton, woven in Italy
Oversized fit with dropped shoulder; size down for a closer fit

name: Wool-Blend Overcoat
description: A clean single-breasted overcoat in a recycled wool blend that falls just above the knee, with a notch lapel and a straight cut that sits neatly over a suit jacket or a heavy knit. It comes in charcoal melange or deep navy with tonal buttons and no visible branding. Simple, warm and easy to wear every day of the winter.
details: Three-button front, flap pockets, inside pocket

name: Tycho Wool Car Coat
description: A short, hip-length car coat in Italian wool twill with a fly front, a small turn-down collar and a lightly padded lining for raw Nordic wind. The color is a muted espresso brown with tonal buttons, and the cut is straight and slightly roomy so a lambswool crewneck fits underneath. Functional, understated and better the closer you look.
details: Concealed fly front, slanted hand pockets

name: Alfama Crochet-Trim Cardigan Coat
description: A long knitted coat in chunky undyed cotton, edged all the way round in a wide hand-crocheted scallop trim and tied loosely at the waist. It has the weight of a blanket but breathes like a summer knit, so it covers bare shoulders on a cool evening by the sea. Soft and a little undone over a slip dress or linen trousers.
details: Open front with self-tie belt, two patch pockets

name: Signe Ruffle-Collar Trench
description: A light cotton trench in pale stone with a soft ruffled collar, gently puffed sleeve heads and a rose gingham lining that shows when the belt hangs loose. It is cut close at the shoulder and flares to the knee, so it moves more like a dress than a raincoat. Romantic over a floral midi, crisp over an oxford shirt and jeans.
imageQuery: ruffle collar beige trench coat woman

name: Classic Retro-X Fleece Jacket
description: Patagonia's Retro-X is a deep-pile fleece in recycled polyester, backed with a windproof barrier membrane so it blocks a cold breeze far better than plain fleece. The pile is a natural off-white with contrast nylon trim on the chest pocket, and the cut is easy and regular. It works at a trailhead in October and over a flannel in town all winter.
details: Windproof barrier membrane; recycled polyester mesh lining
Zip chest pocket, zippered handwarmer pockets

name: Torrentshell 3L Rain Jacket
description: The Torrentshell is a three-layer waterproof, breathable rain shell in recycled nylon that packs into its own pocket and comes out on the first wet morning of every season. It has pit zips for venting, an adjustable hood that rolls away into the collar, and a regular fit with room for a fleece underneath. In a burnt orange that is easy to spot on the trail.
details: 3-layer H2No Performance Standard shell, 100% recycled nylon ripstop
Regular fit; layers over a midweight fleece
Pit zips, adjustable roll-away hood, stows in hand pocket
Machine wash warm, tumble dry low

name: Bonatti Waterproof Jacket
description: Salomon's Bonatti is a featherweight waterproof running shell that stuffs into its own chest pocket. Fully taped seams and a 2.5-layer membrane keep rain out on a mountain run, while a close, athletic cut and elastic cuffs stop it flapping at pace. In deep black with a reflective logo, it looks just as right on the street with trail runners.
details: Slim, athletic fit; size up to layer
Hood with rear volume adjuster; stows into chest pocket

name: Light Mountain Cloth Parka
description: A long, roomy shell in Snow Peak's light mountain cloth, a dry, matte polyester weave that blocks wind and light rain while feeling closer to cotton than nylon. The shape is simple and boxy with a large hood, a snap-covered zip and deep pockets, in quiet olive or charcoal. Equally at home at a campsite or over tailoring on a damp city day.
details: Two-way zip under snap placket, adjustable hood

name: Signal Packable Anorak
description: SEOM's Signal is a half-zip anorak in crinkly, lightweight recycled nylon, cut oversized with a big kangaroo pocket and a toggled hood. A hand-drawn graphic of a broken radio mast runs down one sleeve in reflective ink, and the whole thing packs into its own pocket. Throw it over a heavyweight tee with nylon cargos and trail runners.
details: Oversized fit; size down for a regular look
Half zip, kangaroo pocket, toggle hood and hem

name: Windrunner Jacket
description: Nike's Windrunner is the 1978 running jacket that never left: a woven nylon-feel shell with the signature chevron yoke across the chest, a hood that stows in the collar and elastic cuffs. It is light and wind-resistant with a mesh lining that breathes on a run or a long walk, and the regular fit layers over a hoodie. Sporty and a little retro with track pants or cargos.
details: 100% recycled polyester woven shell; mesh lining
Full zip; hood stows in the collar
Zip hand pockets, elastic cuffs and hem

name: Impact Run Water Defy Jacket
description: A light, water-resistant running jacket with a slim, athletic cut, a dropped back hem for coverage and reflective details for dark mornings. The fabric is a soft, quiet woven that sheds drizzle and blocks wind without rustling, and the jacket packs into its own back pocket. Sporty in a pale sea-salt grey with lime accents.
details: Zip back pocket doubles as a stuff sack
